name: Example: Free Swaps
author: byo-pop examples
description: A swap that makes no match stays instead of swapping back, for a few points. A board with no moves left can play on, since a free swap can still make one. Uses its own high-score table.

settings.label: Cost of a swap with no match
settings.help: Points taken for each swap that stays without a match, times the level's point multiplier.

settings.label: It counts as a move
settings.help: On: the first such swap of a game makes it a game in progress, as a match does.

settings.label: Normal
settings.help: Play on: keep swapping. New gems: the board falls out and refills, as Timed does. Game over: as the original.

settings.label: Timed
settings.help: Play on: keep swapping. New gems: the board falls out and refills, as the original. Game over: the game ends.
